name: Kit arrangement in seven shapes
summary: Music bed for soundtrack.mjs played by a sound kit (lib/soundkit.mjs), so the instruments, key, chords, and groove change with every video. Seven arcs: build-drop, cold-open (full groove from beat one, one breakdown bar), stop-time (a stab per bar, then the groove), pulse (no drums, arpeggio doubles at the turn), swell (one crescendo, no drop), stomp (percussion and bass only), ui-only (no bed). Ends on the kit's tonic chord.

params.shape: build-drop | cold-open | stop-time | pulse | swell | stomp | ui-only (default: the kit's shape)
params.turn: bar index where the story turns (drop, groove arrives, arpeggio doubles)
params.endBar: bar index of the final chord (null to skip)
params.kicks: KICKS times from src/cues.mjs (shapeKicks in lib/grooves.mjs suggests them)
params.gap: seconds of near-silence before the turn (build-drop only)
params.melody: false to leave out the top line after the turn
params.pulseGain: gain of the soft pulse that drumless shapes play on KICKS (0 for none)

changelog: v1 2026-10-03: added so beds stop sharing one arc and one instrument set
